'''------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Description: import XML into Maximo using Rest API
Date            Version                      Author                        Comment
===================================================================================================
2024-04-11      0.1                        IBM/Samer Al Fakih           Initial version 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------'''
from psdi.util.logging import MXLogger
from psdi.util.logging import MXLoggerFactory
from psdi.webclient.system.controller import PresentationParser
from psdi.webclient.system.session import WebClientSessionFactory
from com.ibm.json.java import JSONObject
from psdi.server import MXServer
from psdi.webclient.system.controller import IdProperty

logger = MXLoggerFactory.getLogger("maximo.script")

def beforeProcess(ctx):
    logger.info(" Start Importing XML Script - OSIN.IBMXML \n")
    payload = JSONObject.parse(str(ctx.getData()))
    presentation = payload["presentation"]
    appId=payload["app"]
    logger.info("Importing application XML, application name:" + str(appId))
    if (presentation is not  None):
        labels= PresentationParser(presentation).getLabels()
        sqf = "app='" + appId  +"'"
        try:
            maxLabels = MXServer.getMXServer().getMboSet("maxlabels", MXServer.getMXServer().getUserInfo("MAXADMIN"))
            maxLabels.setWhere(sqf)
            maxLabels.reset()
            index = 0;
            while (True):
                mbo = maxLabels.getMbo(index)
                if (mbo is None):
                    break
                existingLabel = IdProperty(mbo.getString("id"), mbo.getString("property"))  
                if existingLabel is not None:
                    newValue = labels.get(existingLabel)
                    if (newValue is None):
                        mbo.delete()
                    else:
                        mbo.setValue("app", appId, 11L)
                        mbo.setValue("id", existingLabel.getId(), 11L)
                        mbo.setValue("property", existingLabel.getProperty(), 11L)
                        mbo.setValue("value", newValue, 11L)
                    labels.remove(existingLabel)
                index=index+1
                
            for label in labels:
                logger.info("Importing new lable " + labels[label])
                mbo = maxLabels.add() 
                mbo.setValue("app", appId, 9L)
                mbo.setValue("id", label.getId())
                mbo.setValue("property", label.getProperty())
                mbo.setValue("value", labels[label])
            maxLabels.save()
        finally:
            maxLabels.cleanup()
    logger.info(" End Importing XML Script - OSIN.IBMXML \n")
